cases.name: edge/protocol-2
cases.why: the compiled 405B schedule under tessera-protocol/2: stage 1 at degree 10, the layer, identity and mask-batching sumchecks, and the fold, column-mask and batching groups

cases.name: edge/empty
cases.why: nothing but the advice and the hash: every other row has no term, and ϑ = 0

cases.name: edge/rate-one
cases.why: weights at rate 1: ρ' ≥ 1, so their queries give no bit

cases.name: edge/line-only
cases.why: a tree level that batches nothing: its line challenge alone, 1/q

cases.name: edge/mask-only
cases.why: a stage that batches nothing in tessera-protocol/2: its mask's ρ alone, 1/q

cases.name: edge/layer-point
cases.why: stage 1's layer point alone, of 126 layers: λ/q = 7/q, in rounds and union (#537)

cases.name: edge/zero-count
cases.why: no round of degree 2^30 counts: the rounds row is 3/q

cases.name: edge/hash-128
cases.why: targets of 128 bits: only the hash reaches one

cases.name: edge/q-below-2^128
cases.why: N + T = 2^64 − 1: 64 − 6.7·10^-10 one-shot bits, which fail 64 since q < 2^128 − 1

cases.name: edge/channel-params-at-a-power
cases.why: tessera-protocol/2, ChannelParams' 944 data rows and B_CP = 80: 1,024 rows, ϑ = 10; one blinding row more would give 11

cases.name: edge/channel-params-past-a-power
cases.why: tessera-protocol/2, ChannelParams' 945 data rows and B_CP = 80: 1,025 rows, ϑ = 11; one blinding row fewer would give 10

cases.name: edge/blinding-below-4
cases.why: B_W = 3 < 4: N_0 = ⌊max(B_W − 4, 0)/6⌋ = 0, so B_CP = B_W and ChannelParams' 2 + 3 rows give ϑ = 3

cases.name: edge/empty-channel-params
cases.why: no weight has channel parameters: in tessera-protocol/1 ChannelParams commits no row, so it has no queries row and no field term, and is not refused (RFC-0049)

cases.name: edge/groups-none
cases.why: the 405B statement were no grouping accepted: the ungrouped union row and rounds row (RFC-0054 'Soundness')

cases.name: edge/groups-union-miss
cases.why: 6,000 level rounds per group at G = 2^14: the union row misses 100 bits at the largest grouping, while the statement without groups passes (RFC-0054 'Testing Strategy')

cases.name: edge/groups-merge-only
cases.why: two groups, no level, a one-round merge of one claim: the rounds row is P + G = 3, the union 2·1 + 1 + 2 = 5
